title: Principal Bands for Mobile Wallet Resend Charges
content:
**Mobile Wallet** resend charges take their form from the size of the transfer.

**Band rule.** The form of the resend charge follows the principal collected on the transfer, that is the total of its funds-received entries:

| Principal collected on the transfer (USD) | Form of the resend charge |
|---|---|
| 1500.00 or more | 0.25 percent of that principal, rounded half up to the cent |
| at least 1000.00 and below 1500.00 | the tier's retry fee plus 0.10 percent of that principal, the percentage part rounded half up to the cent |
| below 1000.00 | the tier's retry fee, flat |

The band edges sit at 1000.00 and 1500.00: a principal of exactly 1000.00 is in the middle band and a principal of exactly 1500.00 is in the top band.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, on a tier whose retry fee is 1.99)

| Principal collected | Working | Charge form |
|---|---|---|
| 999.99 | below 1000.00 | 1.99 |
| 1000.00 | 1.99 plus 0.10 percent of 1000.00 (1.00) | 2.99 |
| 1499.99 | 1.99 plus 0.10 percent of 1499.99 (1.49999, rounded to 1.50) | 3.49 |
| 1500.00 | 0.25 percent of 1500.00 | 3.75 |
| 2345.67 | 0.25 percent of 2345.67 (5.864175, rounded to 5.86) | 5.86 |

In the top band the tier's retry fee plays no part: the charge form is the percentage of principal alone.
